lines.en: Terry, I know that I haven't worked here very long,
but I was wondering, do you think it would be possible
if I got a $100 advance on my salary?
An advance?
It's so that I can spend Thanksgiving with my family.
See, every year we go skiing in Vail,
and normally my father pays for my ticket,
but I've sort of started this whole independent thing,
you know, which is actually why I took this job.
Rachel, Rachel, sweetheart,
you're a terrible, terrible waitress.
Really, really awful.
Okay, I hear what you're saying.
I'm with you.
Um, but I'm trying really hard,
and I think I'm doing better.
I really do.
Does anybody need coffee?
Yeah, over here.
Yeah, I do.
